natural: those near are glad, those far come

meaning.en: When rule is good, people nearby are happy and people from afar are drawn to come.
meaning.zh: 使近处的人高兴，远处的人前来归附，形容治理得好或待人有吸引力。

equivalents: win the loyalty of near and far

examples.zh: 为政者要让百姓安居乐业，近悦远来。
examples.en: Rulers should let the people live in peace so that near and far are drawn to them.

examples.zh: 这座城市以优良环境吸引人才，近悦远来。
examples.en: The city draws talent with its fine environment, pleasing those nearby and attracting those afar.

examples.zh: 好的店铺不靠广告，靠口碑就能近悦远来。
examples.en: A good shop needs no advertising; its reputation draws customers from near and far.

story.en: Duke She asks about governing; Confucius says: 'Make those near glad, and those far will come' (近者说，远者来).
story.zh: 《论语·子路》：“叶公问政。子曰：‘近者说，远者来。’”

usage.en: Predicate; praise, formal. 悦 is read yuè (be pleased); it goes with 近者悦，远者来.
usage.zh: 作谓语，褒义，书面语。

meaning.en: To follow one's wishes straight through to success without obstacles.
meaning.zh: 顺着心意直接达到目的，比喻事情顺利，没有阻碍。

equivalents: get what one wants without hindrance

examples.zh: 他一路径情直遂，从没遇到过挫折。
examples.en: He sailed through, never meeting a setback.

examples.zh: 人生不会事事径情直遂。
examples.en: Life won't go smoothly in everything.

examples.zh: 她在事业上径情直遂，却忽视了家庭。
examples.en: She got her way in her career but neglected her family.

usage.en: Predicate; literary. Compare 一帆风顺, which is more common. Do not confuse 径 with 经.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语。比“一帆风顺”更少见。“径”不要写成“经”。

natural: devoted to work and good with colleagues

meaning.en: To be dedicated to one's work and enjoy working well with others.
meaning.zh: 专心学业或工作，乐于与同伴相处。

equivalents: dedicated and a good team player
love one's work and one's fellows

examples.zh: 好员工应当敬业乐群。
examples.en: A good employee should be dedicated and cooperative.

examples.zh: 学校提倡同学们敬业乐群。
examples.en: The school encourages students to be diligent and friendly.

examples.zh: 他敬业乐群，深受同事喜爱。
examples.en: He is committed and sociable, and colleagues like him.

story.en: The Record of Learning lists the first-year goals: 'by the first year, check whether the student pursues his studies with devotion and enjoys the company of his peers' (一年视离经辨志，三年视敬业乐群).
story.zh: 《礼记·学记》：“一年视离经辨志，三年视敬业乐群。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise; formal. 乐 here is lè (to enjoy); some dictionaries give yào for 乐群, but lè is the usual reading in exams.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，褒义，书面语。“乐”读lè。

natural: embarrassment plain for all to see

meaning.en: To show one's embarrassment or distress fully.
meaning.zh: 尴尬窘迫的样子完全显露出来。

examples.zh: 被记者追问，他窘态毕露。
examples.en: Pressed by reporters, he squirmed in obvious embarrassment.

examples.zh: 演讲忘词，她窘态毕露。
examples.en: Forgetting her lines, she was visibly flustered.

examples.zh: 当众出丑，他窘态毕露，满脸通红。
examples.en: Humiliated in public, he was clearly mortified and turned red.

usage.en: Predicate; slightly mocking. 毕 means 'completely'; lù is the literary reading with 露 in 'reveal'.
usage.zh: 作谓语，略带调侃。“露”读lù。

meaning.en: Exquisitely written words or a brilliant piece of writing.
meaning.zh: 文辞极其美妙，形容写得非常好。

examples.zh: 这副对联绝妙好辞，令人拍案叫绝。
examples.en: This couplet is wonderfully phrased and makes one slap the table in admiration.

examples.zh: 他的悼词绝妙好辞，感人至深。
examples.en: His eulogy was exquisitely worded and deeply moving.

examples.zh: 读到绝妙好辞，他忍不住抄了下来。
examples.en: Coming upon superb phrasing, he could not help copying it down.

story.en: Yang Xiu decodes the riddle on the Cao E stele, 'yellow silk, young woman, grandson, mortar' (黄绢幼妇，外孙齑臼), as 绝妙好辞.
story.zh: 《世说新语·捷悟》：曹操与杨修读曹娥碑背题“黄绢幼妇，外孙齑臼”，杨修解为“绝妙好辞”。

usage.en: Noun; praise; literary. Note the last character is 辞 (words), commonly mistaken for 词 (word), which is also acceptable.
usage.zh: 作名词，褒义，书面语。“辞”不要与“词”混淆。

meaning.en: To rule over the whole empire as sovereign.
meaning.zh: 君主统治天下，也用于比喻在某领域居于统治地位。

examples.zh: 他君临天下数十年，威望极高。
examples.en: He ruled for decades with great prestige.

examples.zh: 这支球队曾在赛场上君临天下。
examples.en: The team once reigned supreme on the pitch.

examples.zh: 一部电影君临天下，票房破纪录。
examples.en: One film dominated the market and broke box-office records.

usage.en: Predicate; literary; figuratively for a dominant figure, sometimes with a sarcastic tone.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语，可比喻居于统治地位，有时带讽刺意味。

meaning.en: To carry on the family's craft or profession, as a worthy son.
meaning.zh: 能继承父祖的事业，多用于称赞子孙。

examples.zh: 他克绍箕裘，接下了祖传的药铺。
examples.en: He carried on the family trade and took over the ancestral pharmacy.

examples.zh: 三代人克绍箕裘，守护着这家老字号。
examples.en: Three generations carried on, guarding this old brand.

examples.zh: 愿你克绍箕裘，光大门楣。
examples.en: May you carry on the family work and bring honour to the house.

usage.en: Predicate; literary and polite; used of descendants. 箕裘 stands for the craft handed down in a family.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语，多用于子孙。“箕裘”指祖传事业。

meaning.en: Empty words are of no help; action is needed.
meaning.zh: 空话对事情没有任何帮助。

examples.zh: 灾情严重，空言无补，必须立即行动。
examples.en: The disaster is serious; talk won't help, we must act at once.

examples.zh: 会议开了几次，却空言无补。
examples.en: The meeting was held several times, to no avail.

examples.zh: 空言无补，我们要拿出方案来。
examples.en: Words alone are useless; we must produce a plan.

usage.en: Predicate or independent clause; derogatory about talk without deeds.
usage.zh: 作谓语或独立成句，批评光说不做。

meaning.en: To have no real knowledge yet think highly of oneself.
meaning.zh: 肚里没有学问，却自视甚高。

examples.zh: 他空腹高心，却瞧不起读书人。
examples.en: He is full of himself but empty of learning, yet looks down on scholars.

examples.zh: 空腹高心的人最容易被现实打击。
examples.en: The proud and ignorant are the easiest to be knocked by reality.

examples.zh: 别做空腹高心的人，要脚踏实地。
examples.en: Don't be one who is proud but empty; be down to earth.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; derogatory and literary. 腹 refers to the stomach as the seat of learning.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，含贬义，书面语。“腹”借指学识。

meaning.en: Spittle flying as one talks excitedly; of someone speaking at length with great animation.
meaning.zh: 说话时唾沫四溅，形容谈得兴高采烈或滔滔不绝。

examples.zh: 他口沫横飞地讲了一个小时。
examples.en: He held forth for a whole hour, spittle flying.

examples.zh: 推销员口沫横飞，说得天花乱坠。
examples.en: The salesman talked non-stop with great flourish.

examples.zh: 两人争得口沫横飞，谁也不让谁。
examples.en: The two argued vehemently, neither willing to give way.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; humorous or mildly derogatory. Often with 地 in modifier position.
usage.zh: 作谓语、状语，带幽默或略含贬义。

meaning.en: To cry loudly and wipe away tears; to weep pitifully.
meaning.zh: 大声哭泣，不停擦眼泪，形容哭得很伤心或装可怜。

examples.zh: 别哭天抹泪的，事情总会有办法。
examples.en: Stop all that wailing; we'll find a way.

examples.zh: 孩子摔了一跤，哭天抹泪地回家。
examples.en: The child fell and went home sobbing loudly.

examples.zh: 她哭天抹泪地向丈夫诉苦。
examples.en: She wept and complained to her husband.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; colloquial, sometimes mildly derogatory because it suggests melodrama. 抹 here is mǒ.
usage.zh: 作谓语、状语，口语，有时略含贬义。

natural: settle kindnesses and grudges with satisfaction

meaning.en: To repay favours and avenge wrongs freely and with satisfaction, as heroes in martial-arts stories do.
meaning.zh: 痛快地报恩报仇，多用于描写江湖侠客。

equivalents: live a life of free-wheeling justice

examples.zh: 武侠小说描写的是快意恩仇的江湖。
examples.en: Martial-arts novels depict a world of settled scores and free justice.

examples.zh: 他向往快意恩仇的生活。
examples.en: He yearns for a life of open justice.

examples.zh: 现代社会不能快意恩仇，要依法解决矛盾。
examples.en: In modern society one cannot take revenge freely; disputes are settled by law.

usage.en: Phrase; mostly used for wuxia fiction and romantic fantasy; not an endorsement of vigilantism. Appears in modern writing.
usage.zh: 多见于武侠小说及评论，不是提倡私刑。

natural: be generous and lenient at heart

meaning.en: To be tolerant and magnanimous towards others' faults.
meaning.zh: 心胸宽广，待人宽容。

examples.zh: 请您宽大为怀，原谅他这次过失。
examples.en: Please be magnanimous and forgive his fault this once.

examples.zh: 法官对初犯宽大为怀，从轻处理。
examples.en: The judge was lenient with the first offender.

examples.zh: 领导宽大为怀，不计前嫌。
examples.en: The leader was generous and held no grudges.

usage.en: Predicate; formal; often a request. Common in appeals for forgiveness.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语，常用于恳请宽恕。

natural: a mad dog barking at the sun

meaning.en: A mad dog barking at the sun: ignorance baying at something great, or a futile attack on something noble.
meaning.zh: 疯狗对着太阳狂叫，比喻无知者对贤者或伟大事物的无端攻击。

examples.zh: 这种攻击不过是狂犬吠日，伤不了他分毫。
examples.en: This attack is just barking at the sun and cannot hurt him.

examples.zh: 对他的恶意诋毁无异于狂犬吠日。
examples.en: Malicious slander against him is like a dog howling at the sun.

examples.zh: 别理会这些狂犬吠日的言论。
examples.en: Ignore remarks like these, that bark in vain.

usage.en: Predicate or noun; derogatory, directed at the attackers. Similar to 蜀犬吠日 but with 'mad' dog.
usage.zh: 作谓语、名词，含贬义，指攻击者。与“蜀犬吠日”形式相近，但本条强调“狂”。

natural: learn through struggle and act with effort

meaning.en: To gain knowledge only through struggle and to act through hard effort.
meaning.zh: 经历困难才获得知识，努力勉强才付诸实行。

examples.zh: 天资一般的人只有困知勉行，才能有所成就。
examples.en: Those of average talent can achieve only by learning the hard way.

examples.zh: 他自述一生困知勉行，从不敢懈怠。
examples.en: He said he had learnt by effort all his life and never relaxed.

examples.zh: 困知勉行，也能成为大家。
examples.en: Even those who learn through struggle can become masters.

story.en: The Doctrine of the Mean: some know it by birth, some by study, some by struggle; and they act easily, profitably, or with effort (或生而知之，或学而知之，或困而知之……或勉强而行之).
story.zh: 《礼记·中庸》：“或生而知之，或学而知之，或困而知之，及其知之，一也。或安而行之，或利而行之，或勉强而行之，及其成功，一也。”

usage.en: Predicate; literary and sincere; originally one of the three levels of learning in the Zhongyong (生知安行, 学知利行, 困知勉行).
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语。出自《中庸》三种境界：生知安行、学知利行、困知勉行。

natural: with an orchid nature and a fragrant heart

meaning.en: Of a woman: pure, gentle and refined in character; elegant and intelligent.
meaning.zh: 像兰花一样高雅、像蕙草一样芬芳的心灵，形容女子品质高洁、聪慧。

examples.zh: 她蕙质兰心，深受众人喜爱。
examples.en: She is gentle and refined and loved by all.

examples.zh: 这位蕙质兰心的姑娘，写得一手好诗。
examples.en: This delicate-natured girl writes lovely poems.

examples.zh: 母亲蕙质兰心，教会我如何做人。
examples.en: My mother, graceful in mind, taught me how to be a person.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; praise; used for women; formal and poetic.
usage.zh: 作定语、谓语，褒义，多用于女性，书面语。

natural: suitable for young and old alike

meaning.en: Suitable for people of all ages.
meaning.zh: 老人和年轻人都适合。

examples.zh: 这部动画片老少咸宜。
examples.en: This cartoon is suitable for all ages.

examples.zh: 这种运动老少咸宜，坚持下去有益健康。
examples.en: This sport suits young and old, and sticking with it is healthy.

examples.zh: 这道汤口味清淡，老少咸宜。
examples.en: The soup is mild in taste and suits young and old alike.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 咸 means 'all', not 'salty'. A classic exam item (咸 ≠ 成).
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语。“咸”意为“都”，不是“咸淡”的咸。

meaning.en: To take pleasure in doing good deeds without ever tiring of them.
meaning.zh: 乐于做好事，从不厌倦。

examples.zh: 他一生乐善不倦，捐助了许多学校。
examples.en: All his life he never tired of doing good and funded many schools.

examples.zh: 这位乐善不倦的老人受到全镇人的尊敬。
examples.en: This tireless benefactor is respected by the whole town.

examples.zh: 乐善不倦的人往往得到好报。
examples.en: Those who never tire of kindness often reap reward.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; praise; 乐 is lè (delight in) and 倦 is juàn.
usage.zh: 作谓语、定语，褒义。“乐”读lè。

meaning.en: Eyes full of tears so that vision is blurred.
meaning.zh: 眼里含满泪水，视线模糊。

examples.zh: 她泪眼婆娑地望着远去的火车。
examples.en: With tear-filled eyes she watched the train pull away.

examples.zh: 老人泪眼婆娑，抚摸着旧照片。
examples.en: The old man, eyes brimming, touched the old photograph.

examples.zh: 他读完信，已是泪眼婆娑。
examples.en: By the time he finished the letter his eyes were swimming.

usage.en: Attributive or adverbial; literary. 婆娑 is originally 'swaying'; here it describes the blur of tears.
usage.zh: 作定语、状语，书面语。“婆娑”本为摇曳，这里形容泪眼模糊。

meaning.en: Lacking the ability to cope with a task.
meaning.zh: 能力不足，担当不了某项任务。

examples.zh: 这个职位太重要，我恐怕力不胜任。
examples.en: This post is too important; I fear I am not up to it.

examples.zh: 他自知力不胜任，主动辞职。
examples.en: Knowing he could not manage it, he resigned.

examples.zh: 勉强让他承担力不胜任的工作，反而误事。
examples.en: Forcing him to do work beyond his ability only delays matters.

usage.en: Predicate; often used as self-deprecation; 胜 is read shèng ('be equal to'), not shēng. Common exam item.
usage.zh: 作谓语，常用于自谦。“胜”读shèng，意为经得起、担当得了。

meaning.en: Trembling with fear in the face of danger.
meaning.zh: 因危险而战栗恐惧。

examples.zh: 乱世之中，百姓栗栗危惧，不知明日如何。
examples.en: In troubled times people trembled in fear of the morrow.

examples.zh: 他栗栗危惧，生怕再犯错误。
examples.en: He trembled in dread of making another mistake.

examples.zh: 面对强敌，将士们不免栗栗危惧。
examples.en: Facing a powerful foe the soldiers could not help trembling.

usage.en: Predicate; literary; also written 栗栗自危. 栗栗 means 'shuddering'.
usage.zh: 作谓语，书面语。也作“栗栗自危”。

natural: a fine craftsman toils hard in his heart

meaning.en: A true master pours great painstaking effort into his work, though it is rarely seen.
meaning.zh: 技艺精湛的工匠，在构思创作中花费了巨大的苦心。

examples.zh: 一件精品背后，是良工心苦的无数日夜。
examples.en: Behind every masterpiece are countless days and nights of a master's labour.

examples.zh: 良工心苦，只有同行才懂其中甘苦。
examples.en: Only fellow craftsmen know how much effort a master puts in.

examples.zh: 他修复古画十年，真是良工心苦。
examples.en: He spent ten years restoring the painting, truly the effort of a fine craftsman.

usage.en: Noun or predicate; praise; literary; often used by critics for art or craft. Usually in the pair 良工苦心.
usage.zh: 作名词或谓语，褒义，书面语。常作“良工苦心”。
